title: Authentic Kashkaval Burekas
subtitle: served Sabich-style with eggplant, egg and tahini
description: Puff pastry half-moons filled with a creamy white cheese and sour cream filling, served opened and stuffed with roasted eggplant salad, hard-boiled egg and tahini. Defrost the pastry the night before.

steps.text: Defrost the puff pastry in the fridge overnight.
Make the filling: mix the cream cheese, sour cream, baking cheese, salt, oil, egg yolk, milk and flour in a bowl and refrigerate for about 1 hour to set.
Carefully unroll the pastry on a floured surface and roll out to 3 mm thick. Cut 10 cm rounds with a cup or cutter.
Pipe a tablespoon of filling onto each round, brush the edges with a little egg or water, fold in half and seal well.
Brush with beaten egg, sprinkle with sesame seeds and bake at 180°C for 15-20 minutes.
To serve, slice the eggplant, place on a baking tray, drizzle with olive oil and bake at 170°C for about 15 minutes until golden. Chop into cubes.
Mix the chopped tomatoes and chopped spring onions in a bowl and add the eggplant cubes. Cut each burekas open across the width with a knife (not all the way through).
Fill each burekas with a spoonful of the salad and a slice of hard-boiled egg (boil 4 eggs for slicing). Drizzle with tahini and garnish with parsley if you like.
